name: pipe-guard
summary: Blocks status-bearing commands (commit, build, test) piped through a status-masking filter — Claude Code sessions only
why: A pipeline's exit status is its last command's, so `git commit | tail` reports success whatever the commit did. Measured three times in one day, the third hours after the journal entry describing it - a reminder does not survive habit, a hook fires instead of memory. REACH: the seam is a Claude Code PreToolUse hook; a harness without that mechanism (devin, grok) gets only the rule text, which this very topic proved insufficient - do not install where no session runs under a hook-capable harness.
after: Claude Code - wire it as a PreToolUse hook for Bash in .claude/settings.json: {"hooks": {"PreToolUse": [{"matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "uv", "args": ["run", ".claude/hooks/pipe-guard.py"]}]}]}}
devin/grok have no hook mechanism - the guard cannot reach them; do not pretend the rule text is protection there
